newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen testing 980 stg support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen testing 980 stg support.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE cocoa futures, which broke an uptrend earlier this week, will remain vulnerable to the downside with July eyeing the 980 stg support, technical analysts said.
Traders called the market to open three to five stg lower.
Adrian Haylor, a technical analyst at Sucden, said cocoa looked set to go much higher until it broke the uptrend on Tuesday. It fell further on Wednesday on speculative selling
"It broke the (April 24's) 1,006 stg reaction low, so in the short-term the market will remain under pressure," he said. "The level to watch is 980."
"975 is a 50 percent retracement from mid-February," he added.
"I think if 980 is broken on the closing basis, I think there's a big risk the market might go back to 900," Haylor said.
At the moment it could hover at the lower end of the current 980-1,060 stg range.
"I think in the short the market will be a bit vulnerable," he added.
The 14-day relative strength indicator at 42 percent is just above the 30-percent oversold zone.

Broker GNI said in a commentary: "The charts seem to indicate the 980 stg support (the lows on April 9) will be critical for the market, but judging by activity at the beginning of last month, then prices may have to consolidate around here."

Activity will be curbed by a public holiday in many European countries on Thursday. Many traders will also be away for London's trade dinner on Friday, which will precede a long weekend in the U.K. due to a bank holiday on Monday. --Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
